name: Notion UI Skills
description: How to handle Notion when the connector tools aren't available.
instructions:
If the notion_* tools are NOT in your tool list, no Notion integration is connected. In that case:
1. Say so plainly and point the user at the drawer menu ▸ Connectors ▸ Notion — connecting takes an internal integration token from notion.so/my-integrations and gives you real search/read/write.
2. Only drive the app's UI with open_app + navigate_app if the user asks you to anyway. It is slow and the editor is awkward to automate: prefer reading over writing, and never try to restructure a page by tapping.
3. Notion's app search is the reliable entry point once inside — open the app, tap search, type the page title, rather than scrolling the sidebar.
